# QRCode.js provenance

- Source: https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs
- Source commit: `04f46c6a0708418cb7b96fc563eacae0fbf77674`
- Bundled file: `qrcode.min.js` (copied without modification)
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The presenter uses this local library to render QR codes in the browser. It does not send player URLs or data to a third-party QR image service.
